Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
October 13, 2009
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 600 Eucalyptus Avenue, Vista, CA
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Pastor Mike Bradford of New Community Church of Vista
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.

Proclamation declaring October 16, 17, and 18, 2009, "Knights of Columbus Tootsie Roll Drive Days" in the City of Vista. (CC)
P2.

Check Register (CC)

Adopt Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2009- , authorizing the Summary Vacation of a Public Sewer Easement within Parcel "E" of Parcel Map 15091; and

C9.

1.

City Council Resolution No. 2009- , approving the first amendment with Gold Coast Surveying, Inc.; and

All-Way Stop on Longhorn Drive at Promontory Ridge Way (CC)
C14.

C15.

1.
City Council Resolution No. 2009- ; and

Buena Sanitation District Resolution No. 2009- .

2008-2009 Community Development Block Grant Consolidated Annual Performance and Evaluation Report (CC)
DISCUSSION
D1.
Proposition 1A Securitization Program Authorization and Amendment (CC)
1.
Approving the form; authorizing the execution and delivery of a Purchase and Sale Agreement and related documents with respect to the sale of the seller's Proposition 1A receivable from the state; and directing and authorizing certain other actions in connection therewith; and
2.
Authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement and related documents on behalf of the City.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
